defs.meaning: 方面；方位；面貌（aspect 的复数）

examples.en: I did notice a couple of unconsidered aspects.
examples.zh: 我的确注意到了几个被忽视的方面。

examples.en: The technical aspects were the concern of the Army.
examples.zh: 技术方面是军方负责的事。

examples.en: An agreement on many aspects of trade policy was in sight.
examples.zh: 有关贸易政策诸多方面的一项协议即将签订了。
